reviews.comment: Easy 5-week summer course! 4 main speeches along with a couple quizzes and some easy worksheets. The majority of your grade will be the written speech outlines and online speech recordings. Worksheets and quizzes helped boost your overall grade. Be ready to spend roughly 1-2 hours each day for this course. In general, great course and instructor!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class
